handoff: Approved: fresh agent launches (start_run, retry_fresh) stop slot-port strays from the worktree and record stopped_listeners in the trace; tests and typecheck green. One minor: retry_fresh path untested.

findings.title: The retry_fresh launch's stray stop is untested
findings.criterion: stop strays before launching an agent step
findings.detail:
agent-strays.test.ts proves the stop and the trace record only for start_run. retryFresh also passes fresh: true and spreads strays(stopped) into its detail, but no test exercises it. This matters because the incident (implement#3 → implement#4) could be a fresh retry as well as a new run.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a retry_fresh case to agent-strays.test.ts, or accept it because it shares launchSession with start_run.
